sv.title: Taxijätte hackad – kunder drabbade
sv.summary: Taxijätten Cabonline, som bland annat äger Taxikurir, har drabbats av ett dataintrång som inneburit att obehöriga stulit information om taxibokningar.

en.title: Taxi giant hacked – customers affected
en.summary: Taxi giant Cabonline, which among other things owns Taxikurir, has been hit by a data breach that has allowed unauthorised persons to steal information about taxi bookings.
